label: NWS Local Storm Reports → TAK
info:
Storm reports from spotters, emergency managers and the public (tornadoes, wind damage, hail, flooding) for Tennessee, last 24 hours.

Data: Iowa Environmental Mesonet LSR feed (https://mesonet.agron.iastate.edu/request/gis/lsrs.phtml). Updates every 5 minutes.

Setup:
1. Double-click TAK Server :8089, set your TAK Server address, then edit its TLS config and upload your client certificate and key.
2. Click Deploy.

Full instructions: https://github.com/SECT0101/NodeRED-TAK/tree/main/flows/nws-storm-reports
